doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Riverside and the New York scene
title: The tuna sandwich and a reputation for unreliability
summary: Ware gets sick after eating and leaves the Five Spot, and people decide he is unreliable although he is usually first on the gig.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So I went around to this little place and got me a -- I'll never forget -- I should have gotten a hot sandwich, but I got a tunafish salad, ate it, and oh boy, it ate the pit of my stomach and I was sick; so sick I was afraid and I just took a taxi. I made a call ... I called up one of the bass players that lived right around the corner from me, and asked him if he would work in my place, and I went on home. Keepnews

And the next day, Keith says, "What you do?" and Joe Termini told Monk to told me that they were gonna get rid of me; I was unreliable that followed me, but I still made it. They always feel that you couldn't depend (unintelligible) always down on Wilbur Ware, and yet, I would be the first on on the gig.
It was strange, I'd be the first one there, on time, ready to play, but they just knew that I was gonna mess up.
